meta.title: Moving FAQ — Vancouver, WA & Portland, OR | Pricing & Insurance
meta.description: Answers to the most common moving questions: cost, pricing structure, insurance, what's included, booking timelines. Based on 500+ moves in Vancouver, WA and Portland, OR.
meta.ogTitle: Moving FAQ — Pricing, Insurance, Process | GOAT Movers
meta.ogDescription: Get answers on pricing, insurance, same-day service, and more. Straight answers from GOAT Movers serving Vancouver, WA and Portland, OR.

faqs.question: How much does a local move cost?
faqs.answer: Our local moving rate is $125/hour with a 3-hour minimum. Most studio or 1-bedroom moves take 2–3 hours, while a 2–3 bedroom home typically takes 4–6 hours. No charge for stairs or standard equipment.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking at least 1–2 weeks in advance, especially during peak moving season (May–September). Last-minute moves may be available depending on our schedule.

faqs.question: Do you move on weekends and holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer moves 7 days a week including weekends. Holiday availability may vary — contact us to check scheduling.

faqs.question: What areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: We’re based in Vancouver, WA and serve the entire Portland–Vancouver metro area, including Beaverton, Hillsboro, Tigard, Gresham, Lake Oswego, and beyond.

faqs.question: Are you licensed and insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. GOAT Movers is fully licensed (USDOT #4232069, MC #1637475) and insured. We hold active interstate authority through FMCSA.

faqs.question: How long does a typical move take?
faqs.answer: A studio or 1-bedroom usually takes 2–3 hours, a 2–3 bedroom home takes 4–6 hours. Larger homes may take a full day. We’ll give you a time estimate when you book.

faqs.question: Do I need to be present during the move?
faqs.answer: We recommend being present at the start and end of the move to walk through any special instructions. If you can’t be there, you can designate a representative.

faqs.question: Do you disassemble and reassemble furniture?
faqs.answer: Yes — basic furniture disassembly and reassembly (bed frames, tables, shelving) is included at no extra charge.

faqs.question: How do you protect furniture and fragile items?
faqs.answer: We use professional moving blankets, shrink wrap, and straps for all furniture. Specialized TV boxes, mattress covers, and custom crating are available for fragile items.

faqs.question: What if something gets damaged during the move?
faqs.answer: All moves include basic cargo coverage. If any item is damaged, report it to our team within 24 hours and we’ll work with you to resolve it promptly.

faqs.question: What’s included in the hourly rate?
faqs.answer: The moving truck, fuel, all equipment (dollies, blankets, straps), and our professional movers. No hidden fees or surprise charges.

faqs.question: Do you charge for travel time?
faqs.answer: Travel time is billed at our standard hourly rate from our location to your pickup and back. We’re transparent about this — no hidden surcharges.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, credit/debit cards, Venmo, Zelle, and CashApp. Payment is collected at the end of the move.

faqs.question: Is there a deposit required?
faqs.answer: For local moves, no deposit is needed. Long-distance moves require a deposit to secure your date, which is applied to your final balance.

faqs.question: Do you offer free estimates?
faqs.answer: Yes! Contact us with your move details and we’ll provide a free, no-obligation estimate. For the most accurate quote, we may ask about inventory size and distance.

faqs.question: Do you offer packing services?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional packing is available as an add-on. We provide tape, shrink wrap, mattress covers, and boxes. You’re also welcome to use your own materials.

faqs.question: Do you handle long-distance moves?
faqs.answer: Yes. We’re licensed for interstate moves and handle long-distance relocations from the Pacific Northwest to destinations across the US.

faqs.question: Can you move specialty items like pianos or safes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have experience with heavy and specialty items including pianos, safes, and large appliances. Let us know in advance so we can plan accordingly.

faqs.question: Do you offer storage solutions?
faqs.answer: We can coordinate short-term storage through our partner facilities. Contact us for details and availability.

faqs.question: Do you move commercial or office spaces?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer commercial moving services for offices and businesses. Weekend and after-hours moves are available to minimize disruption.

faqs.question: What kind of insurance do you carry?
faqs.answer: We carry full liability insurance and cargo coverage. Every move is protected from start to finish.

faqs.question: What does basic cargo coverage include?
faqs.answer: Basic coverage is included with every move at no additional cost. It provides protection based on the weight of the item.

faqs.question: Can I purchase additional coverage?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you have high-value items, we offer full-value protection options. Ask us about this when booking your move.

faqs.question: How do I file a damage claim?
faqs.answer: Report any damage within 24 hours of your move by contacting our team. We’ll document the issue and work toward a fair resolution as quickly as possible.

faqs.question: Are my belongings covered during loading and transport?
faqs.answer: Yes — your items are covered from the moment we load them until they’re placed in your new home. Our movers use protective equipment on every job.
